description: Update the morning scripts outside the repo so the user can just double-click 1-检查并推送.bat again: pin the new heads and whitelists, upgrade the already-imported local branches and existing worktrees from the known old heads by fast-forward only (never overwrite), provide lock-matched dependencies to the test worktrees, and make the retirement collector a must-pass test. Update s05b-prepare.ps1 to the new control commit. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (final heads).
steps: Read D:\运营管理系统\.codex-tmp\rework-20261024\push-rework.ps1 and s05b-prepare.ps1 fully. Both are UTF-8 WITH BOM, Windows PowerShell 5.1. Keep BOM and CRLF/LF style as found. PowerShell pitfalls already hit this morning: string concatenation inside array literals must be parenthesized; native command stdout inside functions pollutes return values (send to Out-Host or capture explicitly).

push-rework.ps1 constants: $ExpectedHead = new rework head (FEAT-002), $ExpectedControlHead = new control head (FEAT-001). Add $PreviousHead = '087a8348c0b2360267966e179054cd1c5e328dbf' and $PreviousControlHead = 'd1b6049648bc6511431467f126c8e8f38ae8789a' (the only heads that may be upgraded). Update the header comment.

Whitelists: regenerate $Whitelist from git diff --name-only a6cc9fcd <newReworkHead> and $ControlWhitelist from git diff --name-only a6cc9fcd <newControlHead> in the scratch repo (with core.quotepath=false so Chinese paths are literal); they must be exactly equal. $ControlToolsDelta unchanged (verify).
Step 1 chain checks: additionally require $PreviousHead is an ancestor of $ExpectedHead and $PreviousControlHead is an ancestor of $ExpectedControlHead.

Import-Branch rewrite (step 3): if the local branch does not exist, keep the current fetch path. If it exists and equals the new head: skip. If it equals the known previous head: fetch the scratch branch objects without writing a branch ref (git fetch --no-tags <Scratch> refs/heads/<name>, then verify git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD equals the new head), verify merge-base --is-ancestor previous new, then: if the branch is checked out in a worktree (parse git worktree list --porcelain for 'branch refs/heads/<name>'), require that worktree HEAD equals previous and has no tracked modifications, and run git -C <thatWorktree> merge --ff-only <new> (git refuses on conflicting local changes; on failure Stop-Run with a plain Chinese message); otherwise git update-ref -m 'release-rework: fast-forward to reviewed head' refs/heads/<name> <new> <previous> (compare-and-swap). Verify the branch now equals the new head. Any other existing value: Stop-Run as before ('不覆盖').

Ensure-Worktree (step 4): if the path exists with HEAD == expected: ok. If HEAD == the known previous head for that worktree: for the detached control-test worktree run git -C <path> checkout --detach <new>; the branch worktree was already moved by Import-Branch. Otherwise Stop-Run. Clean check before tests: tracked modifications (porcelain lines not starting with '??') abort; untracked-only leftovers from the previous run are listed as a yellow warning and do not abort (do not delete anything).

Dependencies for tests: add $DepsSource = 'D:\codex-isolated\main-manual-release-20261016\dependencies-8ec00f', $DepsCopy = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'deps-8ec00f', $DepsLockSha = '8ec00f801aff894796d783595d202811bccbe94296603ae26766864247d4a4ca'. Function Ensure-Dependencies: if $DepsCopy\package-lock.json missing or hash differs, robocopy $DepsSource
ode_modules to $DepsCopy
ode_modules (/E /R:1 /W:1 /NFL /NDL /NP /MT:16; exit code >= 8 is failure) and copy package-lock.json/package.json; then require $DepsCopy\package-lock.json SHA256 == $DepsLockSha and node_modules	ypescript, esbuild, tsx\dist\loader.mjs exist. Function Connect-Dependencies <root>: require <root>\package-lock.json SHA256 == $DepsLockSha; if <root>
ode_modules is absent create a junction (New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path ... -Target $DepsCopy
ode_modules) and remember it in a script-scope list; if it exists and is a junction to $DepsCopy
ode_modules reuse it (do not remember); anything else Stop-Run without touching it. Call it for $Worktree and $ControlTestWorktree before tests and for $BaseWorktree right after it is ensured/created inside Invoke-TestSuite. Function Remove-CreatedJunctions removes only remembered junctions with cmd /c rmdir "<path>" (never recursive, never Remove-Item -Recurse), verifies the deps copy still exists; call it in Stop-Run before exit and after the test phase on success. The source dir under D:\codex-isolated is only read.
Use the lock-matched tsx: set $TsxLoader to Join-Path $DepsCopy 'node_modules\tsx\dist\loader.mjs' (check existence after Ensure-Dependencies).

Remove the 'tests/preparation-retirement-collector.test.mjs' entry from $KnownExpected (it must now pass); keep the start-timing rule unchanged. Keep $EnvironmentPattern and blocking classes unchanged.
Final messages: unchanged flow, but mention in the completion text the new control head for S05b.

s05b-prepare.ps1: set $ControlCommit to the new control head; update every literal mention of d1b60496 in comments, headings and the artifacts folder name prefix ('control-upgrade-<new8>-...'). Do not change any other logic.

Verify: PS 5.1 parse errors 0 for both files (powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command with [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile); BOM present (first bytes EF BB BF); whitelists equal the git diffs (compute in a separate PowerShell command and compare); dot-source-free unit check of new helper functions where practical by extracting them into a temporary script under %TEMP% (e.g. junction create/remove against a temp dir and a temp target, worktree-list porcelain parsing on a sample string). Do not run push-rework.ps1 itself in the sandbox. Remove temp files.

Environment classification fix (found after FEAT-001): two of the four morning env failures are not missing dependencies. fixed-schema-rejection test "actual control bundle imports selected capability and fixed readers without outside dependencies" copies tests/fixtures/legacy-preparation-tools.mjs controlFiles into D:\codex-artifacts\... and fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND "Cannot find module D:\codex-artifacts\...\preparation-retirement-admission.mjs" because publish-latest-main.mjs already imports that file at base a6cc9fcd; main-publication-readiness test "actual packaged Node CLI refuses missing preparation before loading native engines" copies a fixed tool list without publish-main-step.mjs, which publish-prepared-main.mjs already imports statically at base. By code reading both fail identically at base (pre-existing), but $EnvironmentPattern (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND|Cannot find module|Cannot find package) classifies them as blocking 环境失败 before any baseline comparison. Change the environment rule so only unresolved PACKAGES (bare specifiers) count as 环境失败: match "Cannot find package" or "Cannot find module '<bare>'" where the quoted specifier does not start with a drive letter path, ./, ../, / or file: (e.g. regex: Cannot find package|Cannot find module '(?![A-Za-z]:[\\/]|\.{1,2}[\\/]|/|file:)). Missing relative/absolute module files then fall through to the normal path (known-expected check, then baseline re-run; same-name failure on base = 既有问题, otherwise 新失败). Keep the rule that a remaining missing package still blocks (deps are now provided, so it would indicate a real setup problem). Add a comment explaining this. Unit-check the new regex in a temp script against the four morning messages: typescript/esbuild "Cannot find package" -> env; the D:\codex-artifacts and C:\Users\...\候选包 "Cannot find module" absolute paths -> not env.
acceptance_criteria: push-rework.ps1 pins the new heads, whitelists equal the actual diffs, accepts only the known previous heads for fast-forward upgrade and otherwise refuses to overwrite
Test worktrees get a node_modules junction to a lock-verified dependency copy; junctions created by the script are removed on success and on abort, only via non-recursive rmdir
Collector is no longer in KnownExpected; start-timing rule unchanged
s05b-prepare.ps1 uses the new control commit everywhere
Both scripts parse with 0 errors under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and keep the UTF-8 BOM
Environment pattern only treats unresolved bare package specifiers as 环境失败; absolute/relative missing module files go through baseline comparison
verification: Whitelist comparison against git -c core.quotepath=false diff --name-only a6cc9fcd <head> for both heads shows exact equality
Temporary helper-function check for junction create/remove and worktree porcelain parsing passes

Branch worktree call passes previous as empty string.
